segments.text: "I want you to look for the culprit together with me."

Kakeru's classmate. Kujo is the heir apparent to a massive commercial conglomeration, not to mention a beautiful, well-mannered girl. Though she tends to be serious and straitlaced, she has flashes of humor. Between her earnest kindness and good looks, she's popular among both boys and girls.

Despite her family's affluence, she's quite the penny pincher and considers going out for fast food to be splurging. She works part-time at the café her grandfather owns, trying to build real-life experience and save money.

Kujo is a straight-A student, but she thinks of herself as hard-headed, so she values the protagonist's flexible mindset. Soon enough, she comes to rely on him, and it isn't long before she opens up and shows him her warmer side.
Having awakened to supernatural powers when she obtained a mysterious piece of jewelry, an Artifact, she's driven by her strong sense of justice to solve the mysteries around town.
From Steam

Her ability allows her to steal things on a range of 10 meters and even makes the former owner forget about the stolen item. The stolen object is not restricted to physical means; it can be sight or memories, and the user should know the target very well.
白泉学園２年生。主人公のクラスメイト。
世界的に有名な企業のお嬢様かつ、100人が100人認める美少女。
性格は基本的にしっかり者だが、たまに抜けたところもあり男女問わず人気を集めている。
いわゆるお金持ちのお嬢様であるが、本人の金銭感覚は超がつくほど庶民的。
優等生的な自分とは違った考え方の出来る主人公のことをとても信頼していて、主人公に対しては時にいたずらっぽい一面を覗かせることも。
祖父の経営する喫茶店で社会勉強のためアルバイトをしている。
不思議な装飾品「アーティファクト」を手に入れたことによって異能に目覚め、持ち前のつよい正義感を発揮し事件の解決に乗り出す。
世界的に有名な企業のお嬢様かつ、１００人が１００人認める美少女。
性格は基本的にしっかり者だが、たまに抜けたところもあり男女問わず人気を集めている。
いわゆるお金持ちのお嬢様であるが、本人の金銭感覚は超がつくほど庶民的。
"U-um... n-no... it's nothing..."
Kakeru's senpai.

Timid and docile, Kosaka is a shrinking violet, a quiet beauty who manages to stay in the background at her school... at least until something sparks a boom in her desirability, and every boy around suddenly can’t get enough of waiting on her hand and foot.
She becomes interested in the protagonist after he shows some concern for her, but this makes Kujo, who has been growing closer to the protagonist, feel angry and jealous.
The details of her ability are unknown, and she becomes a person of interest in the case after Kujou and the protagonist remark on her willingness to use her powers on others without hesitation.
Actually, she is bad at cooking.
Hobbies: Drawing manga, watching anime
Likes: Sweets
Dislikes: Being the center of attention
From Steam
主人公たちの先輩。
気が小さくおとなしい性格であまり目立たない隠れ美少女……のはずだったが、とあるきっかけで異常なほどモテはじめ、周囲に女王様扱いされている。
自分を気にかけてくれた主人公を好きになるが、主人公と仲の良い都にモヤモヤし、嫉妬してしまうように。
能力の詳細は不明であるが、迷うことなく力を他者につかう要注意人物である。
主人公たちの先輩。

とあるきっかけで異常なほどモテはじめ、周囲に女王様扱いされている。
自分を気にかけてくれた主人公を好きになるが、主人公と仲の良い都にモヤモヤし、嫉妬してしまうように。
"You're not half as nice to me as you oughta be, Nii-ni."
Kakeru's cheeky younger sister, a first-year student.

Sora spends most of her spare time hanging out at the protagonist's apartment, often threatening to move in and sometimes making him treat her to dinner. She has a selfish side, but her dedication to her brother is undeniable. She enjoys teasing Miyako for her overly-serious demeanor and occasional slip-ups.
When Sora awakens to her powers, she begins cooperating with Miyako and her brother on the investigation.
Hobbies: Playing (games, exercising, anything)
Likes: Everything fun
Dislikes: Being bored
Edited from Steam

She is a user, and her artifact is a bracelet. She can erase people, objects, and herself, or in other words, make them invisible temporarily. However, it doesn't affect powerful beings or users with strong Defend-type artifacts. If she forces herself to erase something until it loses its existence, her power may go out of control and potentially slowly erase her from this world.
白泉学園１年生。
無邪気で誰とでも物怖じせずに話せる、社交的な性格の妹。
主人公の家に居座ったり、ご飯をおごらせたりと気ままな態度を取ることもあるが、それも兄妹仲の良さの現れ。
真に受けやすくかわいい反応をする都をからかって遊ぶのがマイブーム。
気づいたら異能に目覚めており、なんとな～く兄と都に協力する。
白泉学園１年生。
無邪気で誰とでも物怖じせずに話せる、社交的な性格の妹。
主人公の家に居座ったり、ご飯をおごらせたりと気ままな態度を取ることもあるが、それも兄妹仲の良さの現われ。
"I can't trust you two."
A second-year student at Kuho Girls Academy.
Shrouded in mystery, Yuuki is an enigmatic girl who attends another school. The only thing known about her is her passion for parfaits.
Hobbies: Creating dollhouses
Likes: Animals
Dislikes: People who act way more familiar than they actually are
From Steam
玖方女学院２年生。
謎の多い、ミステリアスな他校の女の子。パフェが大好き。
玖方女学院2年生。
謎の多い、ミステリアスな他校の女の子。パフェが大好き。
"Man, what the heck am I gonna do with this thing?"
The protagonist of the story and a second year at Hakusen Academy.
Though he can be a bit blunt, Niimi is a reliable young man with a strong sense of responsibility.
After Kujo explained the Artifacts to him, he joined her on a mission to get to the bottom of the mysterious petrification incidents plaguing the town.
According to Sophitia, he seems to be an Artifact user himself, but he is entirely unaware of it, and his abilities are unknown.
Hobbies: Building plastic models
Likes: Hearty home cooking, meats
Dislikes: People not keeping their promises
Edited from Steam
Spoilers from Episodes 2 & 3
In the Sorairo world line, he is given the flame-manipulating Artifact from Sophitia to fight Ghost and later Magic Eye of Petrification and the ability to summon Ghost in the Haruiro world line.

It is implied that his Artifact is the fabled Overlord. It enables him to shift his existence from one branch of a world line to another, with his memories of the previous branch intact, allowing him to continuously avoid death. He can also extract bits of information from another version of himself, though this ability initially appeared to be involuntary.
Spoilers from Episode 4

Kakeru is given the Artifact that allows him to summon Lena and master it fully. It is later revealed that this is due to his innate ability to draw out Artifacts' potential to their maximum, which Sophie dubs as Overdrive.

Kakeru later discovered that his artifact was not Overlord but a fragment of the Eye of the World. This enables him to "open a door" and make contact with different world line branches, allowing him to inherit both memories and Artifact powers from them.
本作の主人公。白泉学園2年生。
少々ぶっきらぼうではあるが、責任感の強い頼れる青年。
都からアーティファクトの存在を聞かされ、共に事件の真相を追っていくことになる。
ソフィーティア曰く彼自身もアーティファクトユーザーらしいが、まったく無自覚であり能力も不明。
"There's something wrong with you, Kakeru! Don't you have a sex drive?"
Hobbies: Sports
Likes: Parties, girls
Dislikes: Effort
Kakeru's best friend.

Yoichi is a slender boy with a pretty face, and he leaves a positive impression as long as he keeps his mouth shut. Unfortunately, as soon as he starts talking, his horndog nature becomes all too apparent. He likes to think his purpose in life is is to provide maximum comic relief, which doesn't do his popularity any favors.

A natural athlete with good reflexes, he could make something of himself if he could just put in the effort, but that would be too much of a hassle, so he doesn't consider sports anything more than a pastime.
From Steam
He is the actual possessor of the Magic Eye that can petrify people, and is the main culprit behind the petrification incident Kakeru was investigating into.

Along with the Magic Eye, he possesses three other Artifacts that allow him to teleport instantaneously, shoot spears that directly injure a person's soul, and summon a clone of himself - which subsequently is revealed to be Ghost. He appears to feel no guilt over his use of Artifacts to kill people and appears to be related or contracted to Iris in some form.
白泉学園2年生。主人公の悪友。
白泉学園2年生。主人公の悪友。
小柄で黙っていれば美少年なのだが、欲望に忠実な性格でエロにかける情熱はすさまじく、言動は見事に三枚目なのでもてない。
運動神経がよくスポーツ全般を得意としているが、本人は努力が嫌いなのであくまでも趣味レベル。
"Okay, everyone to your seats. Homeroom is starting."
Hobby: Travelling
Likes: Lazing around
Dislikes: Not being able to laze around
Kakeru's homeroom teacher. A graceful woman, if somewhat easily annoyed.

Ms. Naruse can't be bothered to worry about the little things. She's a caring teacher on the surface, but her facade tends to crumble around the protagonist, an old family friend who she tends to complain to when she feels exasperated by her work.
Her family has maintained the Shrine of the White Serpent's Relic for generations, so she can often be found there on holidays, working as a shrine maiden.
From Steam
主人公のクラスの担任。おっとりとした優しい女性。
主人公のクラスの担任。おっとりした優しい女性。
細かいことを気にしない性格かつかなりのめんどくさがりで、私生活はなかなかにだらしない模様。
由緒正しい宝具が奉納されているという白蛇九十九神社の巫女も務める。
"You're overthinking it. There is no good or evil when it comes to the Artifacts' powers."
An unknown life form who sought out the protagonist.
Sophie looks like a creepy plushie, but she insists that it’s only her temporary form while in the protagonist's world and that she's a beautiful girl.

She claims to be a member of Sephirot, an organization that manages the Artifacts and says she was sent to the protagonist's world to begin collecting the lost Artifacts which escaped after the destruction of the shrine’s sacred relic.
On discovering that Kakeru and Miyako are Users, she enlists their help to gather the Artifacts and restore normalcy to the world.
From Steam

A version of Iris that was successful in fending off her insanity and path to ruin due to her Artifacts, she established the organization Sephirot to manage the use of Artifacts and to prevent any loss of life due to their use. She subsequently changes her name to Sophitia, believing it to be a more suitable name for someone who was so unlike the holy maiden that Kakeru's world believes her to be.

Her creepy plushie body is a phantom existence created by an Artifact to make contact with Miyako, Kakeru, and the others. Notably, she is assuming direct control of her phantom, unlike the usual use of such an ability that results in existences like Ghost.
She is aware of Nine's existence and has been attempting to contact them in a bid to stop her evil counterpart.
主人公の前に現れた異世界の謎生物。
主人公の前に現れた異世界の謎生物。
どこから見てもちょっと不気味なぬいぐるみなのだが、これは主人公の世界での仮の姿で、自分の世界では美少女の姿をしているのだと言い張っている。
本人曰くアーティファクトを管理している組織「セフィロト」の一員らしく、神器の破損をきっかけに主人公の世界へ流出してしまったアーティファクトの回収を都や翔に手伝わせる。
「......あなた、なにを言っているの?」
He supports Yoichi unconditionally despite knowing about his identity as a serial killer.
He is a chuunibyou and is implied to have been quite lonely before forming Rig Veda with Yoichi and Ghost.
He likes flat chests.
Episode 3 and 4 spoilers.
An alternate version of Kakeru from a distant world.

Implied to be the player and is the true owner of Overload. Is able to aid Kakeru through Overload due to being an alternate version of him, and is regarded by Sophitia as the ninth and final Artifact User required to defeat Iris.
He is first introduced/revealed to have existed in Haruiro and plays a major role in defeating Iris in Yukiiro.
Kakeru becomes aware of Nine near the end of Yukiiro, and calls him 相棒/Partner.

In the Haruiro branch, Yoichi relinquishes his ownership of the Artifact to Kakeru during the fight against Iris. She maintains her appearance and part of her personality under Kakeru - albeit seemingly no longer as bloodthirsty as she was under Yoichi.
She appears to want a new nickname, as introducing herself as Ghost tends to cause unnecessary trouble.
